vibe_rationale: Builder-led chopper show in its 21st year with real scene depth, but a narrow one-scene format and thin public evidence.
fit_notes: Adult custom motorcycle builders and riders with little health relevance. The only published count (3,500) dates from 2013, so the scale band is weak evidence. Vendor or hospitality presence at most. Kansai-based, so an Australian brand would need a local partner.
